title: Mosaic — An idea becomes a connected system

scenes.title: The idea is set
scenes.purpose: Light rises on a midnight-slate tessera panel while the bulb's tiles flip face-up, so the idea forms out of loose bisque.
visuals: Dark slate wall with a stone-tile panel: an outer slate band, a limestone dotted rule and an inner terracotta band
Midnight-slate field tesserae with 16 sparse gold star tiles
Teal glass disc tiles flip from unglazed bisque to glaze in a wave outward from the centre
Gold-leaf bulb, slate filament and terracotta base tiles flip on the vertical axis just behind the disc wave

beats.development: Fade up from darkness: the key light, hemisphere fill and environment go from 12% to full. The teal disc flip wave starts at 0.16 s.
Gold bulb tiles lift, flip and land in their exact cells. The disc wave reaches the rim.

scenes.title: Connections are laid
scenes.purpose: Loose terracotta tesserae travel into their stored cells in order of network distance from the bulb, and each gold node flips in as its link arrives.
visuals: 61 link tiles start scattered and rotated on top of the field, then lift, travel and settle exactly
Six gold-core nodes with slate rings flip in from centre to rim as the cascade reaches them
A polished dark stone title slab stays still; the title fades in on it

beats.development: Links from the bulb to the first nodes settle. Nodes A and D flip in.
The cascade reaches hub B, then E, C and F. The last tile lands at 2.06 s. The title fades in from 1.5 s, the subtitle from 1.68 s.

scenes.title: The system holds
scenes.purpose: A settled, readable hold on the complete mosaic and title.
visuals: All tiles sit in their exact grid cells
Highlight drift slows and stops at 2.3 s

beats.development: Hold. The key light and environment rotation ease to rest by 2.3 s, then the frame is fully static.

findings: The flip waves are staggered by distance, so glints pass across one region at a time rather than sparkling everywhere at once.
Link travel follows network distance from the bulb, so eye trace runs from the idea out to the system.
Motion ends at 2.06 s and lighting drift at 2.3 s, so the frame is settled before 2.7 s.
justifiedHolds: 2.1–3.0 s: about 1 s of fully legible title exposure on the finished system (the title has been fully opaque since 1.9 s, the subtitle since 2.08 s).

notes: Silent preview: there is no audio track, music, effects or speech.
Rendered with Three.js InstancedMesh and PBR materials. The reviewed Blender/Cycles route could not launch in this sandbox.
